slides.texte_overlay:
Things you should stop doing
as a man in your 20s
Stop spending every weekend recovering. Two nights out that cost you three days aren't worth it. Wake up on Saturday with energy and use the weekend to build your life.
Stop ignoring your health until something hurts. A yearly check-up, the dentist, your eyes. Small checks in your 20s prevent big problems in your 40s.
Stop buying things to impress people you barely know. Expensive trainers, a car loan, designer logos. Spend on experiences and skills that actually change you.
Stop hiding your feelings from the people close to you. Talking to a friend or your partner about what's hard isn't weakness. Bottling it up is what breaks men.
Before: no new ideas since school. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a curious mind that keeps growing long after the classroom.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: no new ideas since school. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Now my mind keeps growing every day.

slides.texte_overlay: Stop staying in a job that teaches you nothing. Your 20s are for learning. If you've stopped growing for over a year, it's time to look for your next step.
Stop putting off learning to cook, budget and fix things. Basic life skills give you freedom and confidence that no salary or job title can ever buy on its own.
